name: webmin-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Webmin system administration. 61 tools across 12 modules covering system monitoring, services, users, cron, packages, files, storage (SMART + LVM), security (Fail2ban), MySQL databases, Webmin ACL, and disk quotas. Four-tier safety framework with safe mode on by default. Python, MIT license, Docker and local deployment supported.
